name: xtra-qc-Utils
author: OpenReview Team
description: Comprehensive compositing quality control and technical review toolset. Features non-destructive diagnostic color adjustments (Gamma, Gain, Softclip Knee highlight compression, Saturation), specialized inspection filters (Grain Check, High-Pass, Black Levels, Negative and NaN pixels, HSL soloing), side-by-side plate comparison with Difference overlay, and advanced RGBA matte inspection with custom channel expressions, alpha overlays, and checkerboard analysis.
